event.description: Tie the first aligned operand-position pair coordinate-wise
event.proposal: Family: position representation. Current retained frontier is 1,672 parameters at 99.010000%, a +0.010000 percentage-point margin over 99%. There have been 8 prior attempts in this family. The most recent accepted result is attempt-0030, which removed the unused final positional row at 2,128 parameters/99.14%; the most recent failed result is attempt-0110, whose fixed Fourier/parity basis scored 0.00% at 1,666 parameters. Hypothesis: the model needs absolute column identity but not separate positional vectors for the two operand roles within an aligned digit column. Tie only positions 1 and 2 coordinate-wise, corresponding to a0 and b0, by checkpoint averaging while leaving the other 30 positions exact; scalar groups already common to both are deduplicated, yielding 1,656 parameters. This is more informative than tying all ten operand pairs because it is the least extensive role-invariance probe and localizes the first carry column before imposing a global symmetry.
